registration_rule: Every threshold, split, family boundary, variant grid, cost assumption and gate in this file was fixed BEFORE any train/validation/lockbox result was computed. Data-AVAILABILITY probes (which databases, watchlists, symbols, date ranges and ledgers exist) preceded registration; no RESULT did. Thresholds may not move after seeing answers; a change would require a v2 protocol that discloses what had already been seen.
question: Can we find a material, robust, after-cost, out-of-sample signal or strategy that deserves to compete for capital against the incumbent, SPY and cash?

verdict_vocabulary.HISTORICAL_ALPHA_CANDIDATE: positive, economically material, after-cost final-OOS result passing the pre-registered robustness and multiple-testing gates
verdict_vocabulary.FORWARD_PENDING_ALPHA_CANDIDATE: historical candidate frozen prospectively; forward evidence immature
verdict_vocabulary.FORWARD_EVIDENCED_ALPHA: forward evidence directionally supportive, confirmation threshold not passed
verdict_vocabulary.FORWARD_CONFIRMED_ALPHA: pre-registered independent forward evidence threshold passed

evidence_ladder.forward_confirmation_threshold: ≥60 effective independent forward observations at the strategy's decision cadence AND net excess over its declared benchmark with one-sided HAC t ≥ 2.0 on forward data alone

equity_panel.source: Norgate US Equities + US Equities Delisted (local, licensed)
equity_panel.pit_membership: norgatedata.index_constituent_timeseries('S&P 500') per security per day; today's list is NEVER applied backwards
equity_panel.price_basis: TOTALRETURN adjusted close for returns; UNADJUSTED close x volume for dollar-volume and price floors
equity_panel.survivorship_treatment: delisted members retained through their membership window; a delisting inside a holding window realises the delisting-path total return present in the vendor series

futures_panel.source: Norgate Continuous Futures (112 markets x 2 continuous methodologies: '&MKT' and '&MKT_CCB')
futures_panel.window: 2006-01-01 .. 2026-09-03; per-market inception honoured, never padded backwards
futures_panel.universe_rule: mechanical: every market with >= 2000 sessions of history and a bar on/after 2026-08-01; no hand-picking
futures_panel.pnl_basis: daily dollar P&L per contract = delta(back-adjusted close) x point value; percent-return arithmetic on back-adjusted series is FORBIDDEN (near-zero adjusted prices fabricate returns)
futures_panel.roll_methodology_check: per market, daily $P&L of '&' vs '&_CCB' compared (correlation, mean |diff| / vol); a family verdict requires the SAME SIGN of the lockbox primary metric under both methodologies

track1_forward_ledger.content: TRUE_FORWARD cross-sections for fundamental_momentum_50_50_v1, composite_sn (fundamental leg), mom_6_1 (momentum leg) since 2026-07-24, with matured per-member outcomes at h=1,5,20
track1_forward_ledger.role: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - no alpha verdict may be issued from this sample

excluded_information_with_reasons.fundamental_quality_value: no NEW PIT fundamental data exists since Stage 23/24/R27 prosecuted these families; registry reopen conditions (pre-2015 PIT vendor) unmet; re-running is repetition, not research
excluded_information_with_reasons.analyst_revisions: no owned survivorship-safe PIT estimate history (Stage 13C OOS failure, Intrinio DO_NOT_BUY); reopen condition unmet
excluded_information_with_reasons.earnings_event_drift: historical PIT earnings timestamps for delisted names not owned; family already on live R46 forward evidence
excluded_information_with_reasons.futures_curve_carry: already prosecuted with the correct capital denominator (R43) and live on R46 forward evidence; historical re-test adds no information
excluded_information_with_reasons.calendar_seasonality: excluded: survives only behind multiple-testing control this sample cannot fund; already an R46 forward challenger
excluded_information_with_reasons.intraday: no owned intraday tape for the tested markets in the window

partition.embargo_rule: ceil(horizon_sessions / cadence_sessions) decision dates dropped from the END of the earlier layer at every boundary; embargoed dates belong to NO layer
partition.lockbox_discipline: variant selection is computed and PERSISTED from validation results before any lockbox evaluation runs; one variant per family enters the lockbox; the lockbox is evaluated once per family; selection artifact timestamps must precede lockbox artifact timestamps
partition.no_test_set_tuning: no parameter, threshold, universe rule or construction may be altered after a lockbox result is seen

conventions.entry_convention: NEXT_CLOSE: signal uses data through decision close t; position effective at close t+1; forward window [t+1, t+1+h]
conventions.equity_cost_rule: one-way turnover sum|dw| x rate, charged to strategy AND to the EW-universe benchmark symmetrically
conventions.equity_eligibility: PIT index member at t AND unadjusted close >= $5 AND trailing 63d median dollar volume >= $10M AND >= 260 prior sessions
conventions.equity_portfolio: long-only equal-weight top-50 by family score (primary); benchmark = equal-weight of the full eligible universe, same cadence, same costs
conventions.futures_roll_cost: every detected roll (Delivery Month change) charges 2 sides on the rolled notional
conventions.futures_sizing: per-market inverse-volatility to a 10% annualised target on 63d realised $P&L vol; portfolio = equal risk across markets; rebalance every 5 sessions
conventions.futures_pnl_measure: portfolio daily $P&L / capital, capital = sum of per-market risk capital at target vol

families.grouping_rule: parameter variations live INSIDE one economic family; the family is the unit of multiple-testing; the validation layer selects exactly one variant per family for the lockbox; the variant grid below is exhaustive and may not grow after registration

equity.note: momentum of SPY-beta residual returns (beta on trailing 252d)
momentum demeaned within GICS sector at t
low idiosyncratic vol of SPY-residual returns

equity.condition: built ONLY from families whose validation primary metric is positive; itself charged in the lockbox BH denominator

futures.note: sign(trailing return) or vol-scaled strength; sizing variants are IN-family
long above trailing channel high, short below channel low, flat inside
long top-third / short bottom-third of markets by trailing vol-adjusted return, risk-balanced

statistics.equity_primary_metric: annualised net excess return of the long-only top-50 portfolio over the EW eligible-universe benchmark, both after costs
statistics.futures_primary_metric: annualised net Sharpe of the vol-targeted family portfolio (benchmark: cash = 0)
statistics.test: one-sided t on period excess returns with Newey-West lag = overlap periods (h/cadence - 1, min 0); daily-marked futures use lag 10
statistics.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q = 0.10 across ALL lockbox primary tests of this campaign (equity + futures + combo counted together); the denominator is recorded in the registry before lockbox evaluation
statistics.prior_search_burden_disclosure: this repository's cumulative discovery burden (~289 prosecuted hypotheses through R46) is disclosed in every verdict; R57 families are pre-registered ex ante, not survivors of a wider silent scan, which is the condition under which family-level FDR is defensible

effective_observations_floor.futures_daily_marks: 500 daily marks and 36 months of span

statistics.small_sample_rule: no Sharpe or t quoted on fewer than the floor; a result on fewer observations is reported as INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE regardless of magnitude

economic_materiality.equity: lockbox net excess >= +1.5%/yr vs the EW-universe benchmark

risk.equity: lockbox max drawdown of the strategy NAV no worse than 1.5x the benchmark's over the same window
risk.futures: lockbox max drawdown <= 25% of risk capital at the 10% vol target

robustness_all_required: validation and lockbox primary metrics share a sign
lockbox split into two contiguous halves: neither half's net primary metric below -0.5%/yr (equity) / -0.10 Sharpe (futures)
selected variant's +/-1 grid neighbours share the validation sign
equity: excluding the largest GICS sector at each decision date leaves the lockbox primary metric's sign unchanged
futures: lockbox sign identical under '&' and '&_CCB' roll methodologies
equity turnover: one-way turnover <= 40%/month for 21d-cadence families (else the strategy is a cost machine and is rejected on turnover)
gates.verdict_rule: HISTORICAL_ALPHA_CANDIDATE requires: effective-observations floor AND BH survival at q=0.10 AND economic materiality AND every robustness gate AND the risk gate. Failing any single gate -> the named rejection.
gates.challenger_freeze_rule: every HISTORICAL_ALPHA_CANDIDATE is frozen as an immutable R57 forward challenger at the next completed session, with weights, cash, decision timestamp, eligible session, universe identity, input hashes, spec hash, cost/construction/risk policy versions and git identity; forward evidence starts strictly after inception; no backfill

calibration_track.applies_to: the strongest equity family that passes its VALIDATION gates (chosen before lockbox)
calibration_track.selection: validation MAE chooses the method and the shrinkage factor from {0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0}
lockbox_evaluation: monotonicity of realised decile means (Kendall tau)
calibration_track.survival_rule: calibration SURVIVES OOS only if lockbox MAE < zero-forecast MAE AND decile monotonicity Kendall tau >= 0.5; otherwise expected_return_state stays NOT_CALIBRATED and that is the published answer
calibration_track.governance: no calibrated forecast enters any governed decision in R57; research lane only

construction_track.applies_to: each HISTORICAL_ALPHA_CANDIDATE (or, if none, the best rejected equity family, labelled diagnostic)
construction_track.shared_kernels: same panel, same eligibility, same cost model, same calendar; risk weights from realised 63d vol only; NO optimiser zoo
construction_track.attribution: signal value = best-construction gross excess; construction value = spread between constructions; transition value = turnover-track deltas

turnover_track.criterion: AFTER-COST lockbox net excess, never turnover itself; a control that lowers turnover and lowers net excess FAILED

track1_diagnostics.scope: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - measures the incumbent, issues no alpha verdicts
track1_diagnostics.forward_ledger: per-component (blend / fundamental leg / momentum leg) buy-side (top-quartile forward excess vs universe mean) and sell-side (bottom-quartile) asymmetry on matured TRUE_FORWARD outcomes at h=1,5,20
track1_diagnostics.historical_replication: mom_6_1-style momentum leg replicated on the survivorship-safe panel with the same buy/sell asymmetry measured on validation+lockbox layers
track1_diagnostics.sample_size_warning: the forward ledger holds ~25/21/8 matured sessions by horizon; every number carries its n
